items.prompt:
All matter is made of tiny particles called:
A) Cells
B) Atoms
C) Fossils
D) Waves

steps: Atoms are the building blocks of all matter.

items.prompt:
A molecule is:
A) One atom alone
B) Two or more atoms joined together
C) A type of rock
D) A living cell
items.answer: B) Two or more atoms joined together

steps: Molecules form when atoms bond together.

items.prompt:
In the formula H2O, the 2 means there are two atoms of:
A) Oxygen
B) Hydrogen
C) Water
D) Carbon

steps: The subscript 2 after H means two hydrogen atoms.

items.prompt:
A substance made of only one kind of atom is a(n):
A) Compound
B) Element
C) Mixture
D) Molecule of water

steps: Elements contain a single type of atom.

items.prompt:
Which of these is a compound?
A) O2
B) H2O
C) A single oxygen atom
D) N2

steps: Water (H2O) contains two different kinds of atoms, so it is a compound.

items.prompt:
How many total atoms are in one molecule of CO2?
A) Two
B) Three
C) Four
D) One

steps: One carbon plus two oxygen equals three atoms.

items.prompt:
Why do scientists use models (drawings or ball-and-stick structures) for atoms?
A) Atoms are too large to draw
B) Atoms are too small to see, so models represent their structure
C) Models are required by law
D) Atoms do not exist
items.answer: B) Atoms are too small to see, so models represent their structure

steps: Models represent particles that are too small to observe directly.

items.prompt:
The formula CH4 represents a molecule with:
A) One carbon and four hydrogen atoms
B) Four carbon and one hydrogen atom
C) One carbon and one hydrogen atom
D) Four carbon atoms only
items.answer: A) One carbon and four hydrogen atoms

steps: C means one carbon; H4 means four hydrogen atoms.
